name: fd
description: Simple, fast and user-friendly alternative to find (Rust CLI)
questions: Q1. Find all `.rs` files excluding `target/`. Show the exact command, then run it and paste the first 5 lines.
Q2. Make the search case-sensitive. Find files matching "README". Run it; paste the first 3 lines.
Q3. Disable fd's gitignore-respecting behavior so ignored files show up. Why does your command reveal them?
Q4. Find one file matching `*.rs` and run `wc -l` on it in a single fd command, using fd's exec-per-result flag.
